name: Sour Gummy Worms
description: Dual-flavour worms coated in our signature sour dust. Soft, chewy, and devastatingly tangy.
longDescription: Our flagship sour gummy worms are dual-layered with two bold fruit flavours in every piece. Each worm is generously coated in our proprietary sour dust blend — a combination of citric acid and natural fruit powders that delivers a face-puckering punch from the very first bite. Soft, chewy, and impossible to eat just one.
ingredients: Sugar, Glucose Syrup, Water, Gelatin-Free Base, Citric Acid, Natural Flavours, Fruit & Vegetable Juice (colour), Coconut Oil, Carnauba Wax.

name: Acid Drops
description: Hard candy with a molten sour core. Not for the faint of tongue. You've been warned.
longDescription: Acid Drops are not for beginners. These hard candies look innocent enough, but crack through the shell and you'll hit a molten sour core that builds in intensity the longer you hold it. Made with concentrated citric acid and natural lemon and lime oils, each drop is a dare in candy form. Our most extreme product — we put a warning label on these for a reason.
ingredients: Sugar, Citric Acid, Natural Lemon Oil, Natural Lime Oil, Malic Acid, Tartaric Acid, Fruit & Vegetable Juice (colour).

name: Mega Sour Strips
description: Flat, chewy, and loaded with sour crystals. Peel, eat, make a face. Repeat.
longDescription: Mega Sour Strips are flat belts of chewy candy rolled in crunchy sour crystals. Peel one off, take a bite, and brace yourself. The texture contrast between the soft, stretchy strip and the crackling sour coating makes these dangerously addictive. Available in a rainbow of fruit flavours, each strip is individually wrapped for maximum freshness and on-the-go snacking.
ingredients: Sugar, Wheat Flour, Glucose Syrup, Citric Acid, Malic Acid, Natural Flavours, Palm Oil, Fruit & Vegetable Juice (colour).

name: Pucker Belts
description: Long, stretchy sour belts rolled in sugar crystals. Sweet meets sour in every bite.
longDescription: Pucker Belts are the ultimate sweet-and-sour combo. These long, stretchy belts have a soft, fruity base generously rolled in sugar and sour crystals. Pull, twist, bite — however you eat them, they deliver a balanced punch of sweetness followed by a tart sour finish. Perfect for sharing (or not).
ingredients: Sugar, Wheat Flour, Glucose Syrup, Citric Acid, Natural Flavours, Fruit & Vegetable Juice (colour), Coconut Oil.

name: Citrus Blasters
description: Explosive citrus-flavoured gummies with a sour sugar shell. Orange, lemon, lime & grapefruit.
longDescription: Citrus Blasters bring together four bold citrus flavours — orange, lemon, lime, and grapefruit — in one bag. Each gummy has a crunchy sour sugar shell that gives way to a soft, juicy centre bursting with real citrus flavour. The sour level is tuned for everyday enjoyment without sacrificing that signature Sour Delusions kick.
ingredients: Sugar, Glucose Syrup, Water, Citric Acid, Natural Citrus Oils, Pectin, Fruit & Vegetable Juice (colour), Coconut Oil.

name: Berry Shockers
description: Mixed berry gummies with an electric sour coating. Strawberry, blueberry, raspberry & blackberry.
longDescription: Berry Shockers are loaded with real berry flavour. Each gummy features one of four berry varieties — strawberry, blueberry, raspberry, or blackberry — coated in our electric sour blend. The berry flavours are bold and authentic, made with natural fruit extracts. The sour hit is strong but balanced, letting the berry sweetness shine through on the finish.
ingredients: Sugar, Glucose Syrup, Water, Citric Acid, Natural Berry Extracts, Pectin, Fruit & Vegetable Juice (colour), Coconut Oil.

name: Sour Keys
description: Classic key-shaped gummies dusted in sour sugar. A nostalgic Canadian candy staple, perfected.
longDescription: We took the classic Canadian sour key and turned it up to eleven. Our version uses a softer, chewier gummy base with a more intense sour coating than you'll find anywhere else. The shape is nostalgic, the flavour is anything but ordinary. Cherry, blue raspberry, and green apple in every bag.
ingredients: Sugar, Glucose Syrup, Water, Gelatin-Free Base, Citric Acid, Natural Flavours, Fruit & Vegetable Juice (colour).

name: Twisted Tangles
description: Braided sour ropes with three intertwined flavours. Pull apart or bite right through.
longDescription: Twisted Tangles are braided ropes of three intertwined fruit flavours, each strand a different colour and taste. Pull them apart to taste each flavour solo, or bite through for the full combo experience. The braid is coated in a sour-sweet crystal blend that adds crunch and a serious tang. Fun to eat, impossible to stop.
ingredients: Sugar, Wheat Flour, Glucose Syrup, Citric Acid, Malic Acid, Natural Flavours, Fruit & Vegetable Juice (colour), Coconut Oil.
